issues.on_page: Local 1,372,636 (budget schedule) = p5 General Fund Local 1,302,283 + sale of surplus 37,997 + insurance proceeds 32,356
issues.issue: As printed, the budget-basis Local lines (General 1,372,636; Road detail[19] 464,029 including sale of surplus 192,942) contain items that the fund statement (p4) puts under other financing. Total detail revenue therefore exceeds receipts by 263,295. A review note is present; flagged so the overlap with other_financing is visible.

'Grants' as a General Government line may be grants/payments to other entities rather than a department total. The 'Miscellaneous' 672,508 line (detail[25]) could likewise be miscellaneous expenditure. These are judgment calls.

issues.on_page: General Fund column Local 1,302,283 (p5), not itemized; county-wide p2: charges for services 977,645, interest income 608,543, miscellaneous 43,906
issues.issue: Mixed line with no breakdown and no dominant part. Road Local 271,087 holds at most 266,645 of public works charges, and the nonmajor and Veteran's Aid Local hold at most 56,724. That leaves the General Fund charges at about 650,000-711,000 of 1,302,283 (50-55%), and the rest (about 590,000-650,000) is interest and miscellaneous. A bare majority of an estimate is not a dominant part. Under the rule (a mixed line with no dominant part and no breakdown is other) the category should be other, with the review note kept.
